freehire_directory.caveat: Mutable paged directory, not an atomic provider export; targeted current identity queries also required.

notes: Maintainer explicitly authorized publication. No auto-merge is enabled.
Additional language sources preserve differing inventories, including Laserax French, English and German; translations can duplicate vacancies.
Canatal currently advertises explicit Canadian and United States roles. No geographic eligibility is guessed for other employers.
Fenplast uses its actual unfiltered AMP listing endpoint, with source-proven city fields, rather than treating WordPress archives as the live board.
D&V Electronics uses the current corporate careers listing. Its WordPress API returned an additional older role absent from that listing; it was excluded.
General applications and talent pools are not treated as current vacancies.
Source posting URLs, not titles or country filters, bound source ownership. PDFs remain valid public application/description destinations; unavailable description enrichment stays visible.
